title: Brackets in Implications
statementMd:
Implication is a function of two logical arguments, its value is false if and only if the value of the first argument is true and the value of the second argument is false.

Implication is written by using character '``', and the arguments and the result of the implication are written as '`0`' ($*false*$) and '`1`' ($*true*$). According to the definition of the implication:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e89bebcd120e22a78239691c68ebf276013ef17.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/af68c40058d777554c00a17c9b5595940af39c06.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7251f8f04d377c9ab47f3d0e3a9f228b43e58504.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b2ab3ebfd5399daf3f3a0ae3fb89fe88e057c9d0.png)

When a logical expression contains multiple implications, then when there are no brackets, it will be calculated from left to fight. For example,

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c37e0d808ad6d8d62f84eebefa9c068efa4bfaf9.png).

When there are brackets, we first calculate the expression in brackets. For example,

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64fe2c9ef6920356045895e641e988348c80ed39.png).

For the given logical expression ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c5d321568dee0b4f8cec503d24bd23b7ccf0dee2.png) determine if it is possible to place there brackets so that the value of a logical expression is false. If it is possible, your task is to find such an arrangement of brackets.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) — the number of arguments in a logical expression.

The second line contains $*n*$ numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7bcdd7440cc300269a3395fa037d5af6351c3221.png)), which means the values of arguments in the expression in the order they occur.

## Output

Print "`NO`" (without the quotes), if it is impossible to place brackets in the expression so that its value was equal to 0.

Otherwise, print "`YES`" in the first line and the logical expression with the required arrangement of brackets in the second line.

The expression should only contain characters '`0`', '`1`', '`-`' (character with ASCII code 45), '`>`' (character with ASCII code 62), '`(`' and '`)`'. Characters '`-`' and '`>`' can occur in an expression only paired like that: ("`->`") and represent implication. The total number of logical arguments (i.e. digits '`0`' and '`1`') in the expression must be equal to $*n*$. The order in which the digits follow in the expression from left to right must coincide with $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$.

The expression should be *correct*. More formally, a *correct* expression is determined as follows:

- Expressions "$0$", "$1$" (without the quotes) are correct.
- If $*v*_{1}$, $*v*_{2}$ are correct, then $*v*_{1}$`->`$*v*_{2}$ is a correct expression.
- If $*v*$ is a correct expression, then $(*v*)$ is a correct expression.

The total number of characters in the resulting expression mustn't exceed $10^{6}$.

If there are multiple possible answers, you are allowed to print any of them.
statementZhMd:
蕴含是一个接受两个逻辑参数的函数，当且仅当第一个参数为真且第二个参数为假时，其值为假。

蕴含运算使用字符 '``' 表示，蕴含运算的参数和结果分别写作 '`0`'（$*false*$）和 '`1`'（$*true*$）。根据蕴含的定义：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5e89bebcd120e22a78239691c68ebf276013ef17.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/af68c40058d777554c00a17c9b5595940af39c06.png)![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7251f8f04d377c9ab47f3d0e3a9f228b43e58504.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b2ab3ebfd5399daf3f3a0ae3fb89fe88e057c9d0.png)

当一个逻辑表达式包含多个蕴含运算时，如果没有括号，则按从左到右的顺序计算。例如：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c37e0d808ad6d8d62f84eebefa9c068efa4bfaf9.png)

有括号时，我们首先计算括号中的表达式。例如：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64fe2c9ef6920356045895e641e988348c80ed39.png)

对于给定的逻辑表达式![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c5d321568dee0b4f8cec503d24bd23b7ccf0dee2.png)，请判断是否可以为其添加括号，使逻辑表达式的值为假。如果可以，你需要找出这样一种括号排列方式。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$）——逻辑表达式中参数的数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7bcdd7440cc300269a3395fa037d5af6351c3221.png)），表示表达式中按出现顺序排列的参数值。

## 输出格式

如果无法在表达式中添加括号使其值等于 0，则输出 "`NO`"（不含引号）。

否则，第一行输出 "`YES`"，第二行输出按照要求添加括号后的逻辑表达式。

表达式只能包含字符 '`0`'、'`1`'、'`-'（ASCII 码为 45 的字符）、'`>`'（ASCII 码为 62 的字符）、'`('` 和 '`)`'。字符 '`-`' 和 '`>`' 只能像这样成对出现在表达式中：("`->`")，表示蕴含运算。表达式中逻辑参数的总数（即数字 '`0`' 和 '`1`' 的数量）必须等于 $*n*$。从左到右，表达式中数字的顺序必须与 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 一致。

表达式必须是*正确的*。更正式地说，*正确的*表达式定义如下：

- 表达式 "$0$"、"$1$"（不含引号）是正确的。
- 如果 $*v*_{1}$、$*v*_{2}$ 是正确的，那么 $*v*_{1}$`->`$*v*_{2}$ 是正确的表达式。
- 如果 $*v*$ 是正确的表达式，那么 $(*v*)$ 是正确的表达式。

结果表达式中的字符总数不得超过 $10^{6}$。

如果有多个可行答案，可以输出任意一个。
